transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

My mom brought me. She... she says I don't do anything anymore. I guess I just can't really make myself do anything. I mostly just sit in my room. I don't really change my clothes. 

I used to knit and journal, and go for walks, but... I don't know. I stopped. When my mom asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to even answer her.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
No. I don't think so. I just... I don't really feel much of anything.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to like, such as knitting and journaling?
Not really. Like I said... I just don't do them anymore. I can't make myself pick up the needles or a pen. It just takes too much energy.
Do you often feel guilty about anything?
No. I don't think so. I don't really do anything... so there's not much to feel guilty about.
Do you still get pleasure from things that most people enjoy, like eating or spending time with friends?

No. I don't really care about that stuff. I mostly just... sit in my room. Usually in the same clothes. I just can't make myself do anything anymore. Even when my mom asks what's wrong, I... I barely have the energy to answer her. So, no.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I don't know... a while. I guess... maybe since I started that community college program. That was... about two years and two months ago, I think.
Do you find that your movements or speech have slowed down?
I don't really know. I haven't... noticed anything like that. I just don't do much anyway, so... I'm not sure.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don't think so. I haven't... really looked. I just eat whatever my mom gives me, so... probably not.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?
No. I... no. I don't think about that.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that aren't really there?
Um... no. I don't... hear anything like that. Just... normal things, I guess. I don't really know.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?

Not really. I don't... do much. I just can't make myself do anything anymore. I mostly just sit in my room... usually in the same clothes. I used to knit, or write in my journal, or go walking. But... no. And when my mom asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to answer her.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
I don't... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed.
Are there any small things that you still look forward to during the day?
No... not really. I just... I don't know. There isn't anything.
Do you ever feel depressed?
I don't... I don't know. I just feel empty, mostly. Not really sad, just... nothing.
Have you had at least two weeks where you felt this way, with little interest or pleasure in activities and significant impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of life?
I don't really know how long it's been. Time just... I don't keep track of it. I don't really do much anyway, so... I'm not sure.
Has there been a time when your feelings of emptiness and lack of interest in activities were noticeably worse than they are now?
I don't... I don't think so. It just kind of... stays the same. I don't really notice a difference.
Do you feel sad?
I don't... not really. Just... what I said before. Empty.
Have you had at least five of the symptoms of depression, such as loss of interest, changes in appetite, or sleep disturbances, for the same two weeks?
I don't... I don't really count things like that. I just... I told you, I just feel empty. I don't really pay attention to my sleep or... whatever else you said. I don't know.
Do you think you would describe your emotional state as depressed, even if you said you don't feel sad?
I don't... I don't really know what that means. I just... I'm just empty. I wouldn't call it anything.
